name: Oath of the Crown
label: Sacred Oath
summary: A sworn defender of civilization who taunts foes and takes damage meant for allies.
flavor: The Oath of the Crown is sworn to the ideals of civilization — to the sovereign who rules, or to the law that binds. Paladins who swear this oath are commonly known as guardians, exemplars, or sentinels, and they are often members of a chivalric order.
playstyle: The dedicated protector oath. Champion Challenge forces enemies to stay near you, and Divine Allegiance lets you soak damage aimed at allies — a true bodyguard build.

features.name: Tenets of the Crown
features.description:
**Law.** The law is paramount. It is the mortar that holds the stones of civilization together.
**Loyalty.** Your word is your bond. Without loyalty, oaths and laws are meaningless.
**Courage.** You must be willing to do what needs to be done for the sake of order, even in the face of overwhelming odds.
**Responsibility.** You must deal with the consequences of your actions, and you are responsible for fulfilling your duties and obligations.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
features.description: As a bonus action, you issue a challenge that compels other creatures to do battle with you. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you. The effect ends if you are incapacitated or die, or if the creature is more than 30 feet away from you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
features.description: As a bonus action, you can bolster injured creatures with your Channel Divinity. Each creature of your choice that can hear you within 30 feet regains hit points equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), provided the creature has no more than half its hit points.

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically substitute your own health for that of the target. The creature takes no damage, and you take the damage instead. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid becoming paralyzed or stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.description: As an action, you gain benefits that last for 1 hour or until you are incapacitated: you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons; your allies have advantage on death saving throws while within 30 feet of you; and you have advantage on Wisdom saving throws, as do your allies within 30 feet. Once used, you can't use this again until you finish a long rest.
